headline: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi Smashes World Record With 53-Ball Double Ton
metaDescription: Fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi set a new world record by scoring a double century off just 53 balls in a recent cricket match against the UAE.
aiSummaryBullets: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi scored 204 runs off 53 balls in a match against the UAE.
The teenager has previously established himself as the youngest captain in men's T20 cricket history.
Experts have noted his biomechanical efficiency and batting speed, while discussing his potential for future cricket formats.
aiContextParagraph: Fifteen-year-old cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has drawn significant international attention after achieving a record-breaking double century in a recent match against the United Arab Emirates. Finishing with 204 runs from 53 balls, the performance follows his earlier milestone of becoming the youngest-ever captain in men's T20 cricket at age 15 years and 232 days. Coaches and former players, including Jacob Oram, have highlighted his technical proficiency, noting his bat speed and minimal movement as key factors in his explosive play. While his recent output in List A and T20 matches has been historic, observers have also suggested that the young athlete will face more demanding challenges as his career progresses. The teenager has publicly acknowledged the pressures associated with these rapid accomplishments as he gains prominence in the cricketing world.
whyItIsViral: The story is widely covered by three independent media outlets following the teenager's unprecedented scoring performance and previous record as the youngest T20 captain.
